purpose: Structural legal-state model. This file defines navigation states, not legal conclusions.

states.label: Tenancy
states.rule: Resolve the tenancy classification and applicable date/regime before applying a state transition.

states.label: Property
states.rule: Resolve the property interest, title/registration status, planning position and other applicable regimes before applying a state transition.

states.label: Social housing application
states.rule: Eligibility, assessment, allocation and review routes must be resolved from the applicable legislation, regulations and official local-authority procedure.

states.label: Planning
states.rule: Planning status must be distinguished from title, building control, environmental requirements and physical reality.

states.label: Mortgage
states.rule: The applicable mortgage, enforcement, court and consumer-protection regimes must be identified before determining procedural consequences.
